messages.text: How many annual leave days can I take?
Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid annual/earned leave per year, accrued at 1.67 days per month. Unused leave up to 10 days can be carried forward to the next calendar year.

sources.excerpt: Annual leave must be approved by the reporting manager at least 2 weeks in advance of planned vacation.
